item.title: Institutos Científicos e Tecnológicos no Sul Global: O que são e para que servem?
item.description: Objetivo: Analisar o papel dos Institutos Científicos e Tecnológicos (ICT) no Sul Global, descrevendo suas funções, estruturas e vínculos com os ecossistemas nacionais de inovação. item.title: Ecoinovação em produtos e processos em uma empresa moveleira
item.description: Objetivo: Verificar a adoção da ecoinovação em produtos e processos em uma empresa do segmento moveleiro para contribuir com o desenvolvimento sustentável. item.title: Exploratory study on adoption of behavioral insights as innovation in brazilian organizations
item.description: Originality: Behavioral insights represent an applied framework that leverages principles of human behavior to address practical and managerial problems, emphasizing systematic experimentation as a core method. item.title: Identifying necessary conditions for university spin-offs in brazilian universities
item.description: Objective: To assess whether conditions inherent to Brazilian universities constitute a necessary condition for the creation of university spin-offs (USOs). Methodology/Approach: We apply the Necessary Condition Analysis (NCA) approach, using data from the Entrepreneurial University Ranking 2021 report, which encompasses 126 Brazilian universities. item.title: Integrating Circular Economy and Industry 4.0 through Dynamic Capabilities
item.description: Objective of the study: This paper proposes an integrative framework that considers Industry 4.0 (I4.0) and the Circular Economy (CE) through Dynamic Capabilities (DCs). Initially, the proposed framework emerged from the literature, presenting seven DCs for integrating I4.0 and CE, along with their subcategories. item.title: Artificial Intelligence in innovation management: Exploring AI
item.description: Objective of the Study: This study aims to investigate the role of artificial intelligence (AI) in enhancing innovation management performance within organizations. Methodology/Approach: An extensive study data is obtained from 261 firms of different sectors, which are already using AI in their innovation process. item.title: An overview of wearable technologies in the military industry
